errors.tooCurved: Cannot create the freeform patch: the normals of the region spread over {{spreadDeg, angle}} (at most {{maxDeg, angle}}). Split the region or use a loft.
errors.tooFewFaces: Cannot create the freeform patch: selection too small ({{count, count}} triangles, at least {{min, count}}).
errors.fitFailed: Cannot create the freeform patch: the computation finds no solution. Check the selection.
errors.invalidSurface: Cannot create the freeform patch: the surface is geometrically invalid. Use fewer spans or more smoothing.
errors.invalidRange: Cannot loft: the end ({{end, length}}) must lie beyond the start ({{start, length}}).
errors.notAnAxis: Cannot loft: the chosen element has no axis. Choose an axis, a cylinder, a cone or a plane.
errors.noSection: Cannot loft: at {{position, length}} the scan gives no closed contour. Place start and end inside the scan or fill holes.
errors.loftFailed: Loft failed: the sections cannot be joined into a body. Change the section count or the range.
errors.notAFreeformFeature: The element is neither a freeform patch nor a loft.

issues.poorFit: Only {{share, percent}} of the triangles are within the tolerance of ±{{tolerance, length}}. Use more spans, less smoothing or a smaller selection.
